newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: UN chief offers sympathy, help to Guatemala.
newsitem.headline: UN chief offers sympathy, help to Guatemala.

text.p: Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali on Thursday offered his condolences and assistance to Guatemala where at least 82 people were crushed to death in an overcrowded soccer stadium.

"As a partner in Guatemala's efforts towards peace and reconciliation, the United Nations stands ready to provide to the Guatemalan authorities whatever support may be required at this time of need," he said in a statement.

The disaster occurred late on Wednesday during a World Cup soccer game between Guatemala and Costa Rica, which was oversold. Angry fans apparently kicked down an entrance door causing spectators inside to casade down to lower levels.
